JSON receipts = Sales + Interest income. Water: 150,668 + 581 = 151,249; Sewer: 95,837 + 4,936 = 100,773; 151,249 + 100,773 = 252,022 = statement total. No transfers or other financing rows printed in the proprietary columns.
